purpose: Measure continuous exogenous nuisance-process structure from primary-stream grayscale frames without using target evidence, biological truth, coupling truth, nuisance truth, or observation-support labels.

inputs.frames: grayscale primary-stream array with shape time x height x width, at least 3 frames, values in [0,255]
inputs.reference_layout: one or more reference zones selected independently of target-observer output, with retained method provenance

measurements.focal_motion_fraction: RMS frame-to-frame mean absolute grayscale change in focal zone, normalized by 255
measurements.reference_motion_fraction: RMS median reference-zone motion trace, normalized by 255
measurements.scale_sensitive_spatial_coherence: positive focal/reference temporal correlation multiplied by RMS amplitude agreement
measurements.reference_stationarity: agreement of reference-motion RMS between first and second halves; static traces give zero dynamic support
measurements.reference_spectral_concentration: largest non-DC spectral-power fraction of centered reference motion trace
measurements.temporal_process_support: maximum of stationarity and spectral concentration
measurements.nuisance_process_index: cube root of spatial coherence x temporal support x absolute reference-motion fraction

design_rationale: target-driven local motion is not nuisance merely because it moves
a spatially coherent exogenous process should be supported by independent reference-zone motion
Pearson correlation alone is insufficient because it is amplitude-scale invariant
absolute reference-motion magnitude therefore remains in the process index
static agreement is not positive nuisance-process evidence
reference-zone selection provenance is part of the measurement record

next_calibration_boundary.required_truth: independently collected exogenous nuisance truth/effect labels on development data only
required_outputs_before_freeze: mapping from process measurements to false-event / missed-event / attribution effects
risk or decision calibration under a prefrozen false-certainty contract
held-out field adapter provenance and hashes
forbidden: choose a field threshold from held-out results
treat process index as nuisance probability
infer nuisance truth from low target evidence
use target-driven coupling truth as positive exogenous nuisance

claim_boundary: Software-level field measurement baseline only; no field nuisance accuracy, calibrated nuisance probability, or held-out decision claim.
